description: Beam load calculator (shear, moment, deflection) — Beam calculator for joists, headers and steel beams. span_ft (or span_m) + load (lb/ft for type=udl default, lb for type=point); optional support=simple|cantilever|fixed, position_ft for point loads, material=wood-df|wood-spf|wood-syp|lvl|glulam|steel|aluminum (or e_psi, fb_psi), and a section: size=2x10 with plies=2, or b_in+h_in, or i_in4+s_in3. Returns reactions, max shear and moment, required section modulus and I for L/360 and L/240, deflection, bending and shear stress, PASS/FAIL verdict, 11-point shear/moment/deflection diagram and dimension lumber that passes. Planning estimate, not a stamped design. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: eng_beam
